description:
• About our brand and products:

FoodFor is a Swiss startup developing functional 60ml shots for mental performance and wellbeing.
We created 4 targeted formulas:
• Focus → concentration & deep work
• Boost → energy & performance
• Calm → relaxation & recovery
• Euphoria → mood & mental balance

Our products are based on vitamins, minerals, amino acids and plant extracts – designed to fit seamlessly into daily routines (work, studying, stress, recovery).

• What makes us different:

• Built for “mental athletes” – people who perform with their brain, not just their body
• Developed with a scientific, neuroscience-based approach
• Compact, practical 60ml shot format (easy to integrate into daily life), while combining 6-9 traditional supplement pills in one shot
• Noticeable effect within 30-60min
• Completed placebo controlled study, proving effects

• How affiliates can earn:

• 20% commission on all standard orders
• 50% commission on subscription orders (first oder)
• 30-day cookie tracking

👉 Affiliates earn commission on every purchase made through their link or code.

• How to promote us:

The best-performing content is:
• Routine-based (e.g. “my workday routine”, “study routine”, “evening routine”)
• Problem → solution driven (focus issues, energy dips, stress, nighttime relaxation)
• Authentic and integrated into real daily life

We provide:
• Content ideas, hooks & scripts
• Product knowledge & science background
• Creative inspiration and best practices

👉 You don’t need a large following – engaged audiences and authentic content matter more.

• Other information:

• No minimum follower requirement
• Recommended: first content within 10 days (we actively repost creators early on)
• Affiliates receive a 50% discount on their first order to test the products
• Open to creators with followers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland
• Payments are handled via our affiliate platform

👉 We are building a small group of motivated creators – quality over quantity.
